title: Brainstorm
summary: A set of proposed features for one decision-maker to read once and pick by number.

summary_table.legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

pick.title: How to pick
pick.markdown: Reply with the numbers you want, for example `1, 3, 4, 7`, plus any changes.
